source_book: Sri Chaitanya — IPE STUDY MATERIAL for Jr. Students, Chemistry (2026-27 edition)
note: Question index for diffing and authoring; stems restated in our own wording, no solution content by policy. Numbering runs continuously 1–60: VSAQ 1–28 (28 entries), SAQ 29–48 (20 printed numbers, 25 entries after sub-part splitting), LAQ 49–60 (12 printed numbers, 24 entries), plus INTEXT SOLVED PROBLEMS 7.1–7.5 (5 entries) = 82 entries. Several SAQ/LAQ items repeat VSAQ wording (16/37, 17/34, 23+24/38, 27/39, 9/58(i), 12/60). Scan pages 85, 87, 89, 91, 93 and 95 are skewed with a tight left margin but every number and star is readable; the footer of scan page 92 is cropped to '4' (printed 94).
